Broke family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar.note: Octavia Broke, a homeless townie; the wiki guesses she descends from, or married into, the Brokes, but nothing confirms it.

GilsCarbo family | The Sims 3 Store | Ba.note: Hard-working single mother Alice and her young daughter Celeste, building a new life in an old town.

GilsCarbo family | The Sims 3 Store | Mo.note: Music-loving Eduardo and devoted Carlotta live simply with toddler Goopy, already fond of cowboys and plaid; the wiki confirms no tie to Sims 2’s townie Goopy.

Matlapin family | The Sims 3 Store | Luc.note: Newcomers Omar and charming Mariana, already popular with the neighbours, and their dreamy, arty daughter Darleen, who hopes to find romance in the desert.

Monty family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte.note: Widowed Silvia, whose son has left to raise his own family nearby; her late husband Valentine has lately started turning up again.

Monty family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte.note: Happy, rich, well-loved Patrizio and Isabella with Bianca, Antonio and a baby on the way; they have yet to meet their future rivals.
Monty family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte.link: Young Patrizio and Isabella, the Sims 2 Veronaville Monty elders, before the Capp feud

Pantalone family | The Sims 3 Store | Mo.note: Vincentio and Francisca, whose only daughter married into the Montys and keeps giving them grandchildren to keep up with.
Pantalone family | The Sims 3 Store | Mo.link: Isabella Monty’s parents; already-dead ancestors on the Montys’ tree in Sims 2

Simovitch family | The Sims 3 Store | Ro.note: Henry, a car-industry tycoon richer than he ever dreamed, still goes to work every day and keeps putting off his promised holiday.

Specter family | The Sims 3 Store | Luna.note: Young, independent Noela is set on a life of crime and has so far stayed a step ahead of the law.
Specter family | The Sims 3 Store | Luna.link: A descendant of the Specters (Olive Specter, Sims 2), the name now spelt Spector

Specter family | The Sims 3 Store | Midn.link: Young Olive Specter of Sims 2 Strangetown, with Nervous before social workers take him

Thebe family | The Sims 3 Store | Roarin.note: Hector and Andromache, thrilled to be reunited with their son Consort in Roaring Heights, have big plans for their grandchildren.
Thebe family | The Sims 3 Store | Roarin.link: Sims 2 Veronaville ancestors, all dead there; Consort Capp’s parents

Alto family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden.note: Bert, once accountant to the stars in Bridgeport, has arrived in the spa town with plenty of money from no clear source; he may be hiding.

Alto family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar L.link: Descendants of the Sunset Valley Altos (Sims 3)

Alto family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunlit.link: Of the Sunset Valley Alto family (Sims 3), due to take over the family business

Russo family | The Sims 3 Store | Monte.note: Sebastiana hates everything and everyone: no friends, no family, and that’s how she likes it.

Loveland family | The Sims 3 Store | Lun.note: Amelia lives alone in an old volcano, hunting for Mr Right, but none of the town’s many bachelors notices her.
Loveland family | The Sims 3 Store | Lun.link: Descendant of Gracie Loveland of Appaloosa Plains (Sims 3: Pets)

Parrott family | The Sims 3 Store | Sunl.note: Clementine reluctantly shares a home with her triplet sisters, party-loving Lucretia and restless Ramona; a fourth sister, Beverly, has died.

Abe family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle.note: Sisters Patty and Serena, total opposites who somehow balance each other out, if they can stay civil.

Anderson family (Hidden Springs) | The S.note: Nature photographer Ryan hopes pictures of the mountains’ magic will make his name; he has a townie brother, Kyle.

Annan family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnac.note: Finn and Flora with four children (Fern, Philip, Fawn and Daisy): a big, rich, famous family in Matey’s Manor; chaotic but loving.

Ansari family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar.note: Grumpy Kara craves money and status but married farmer Raja, who is secretly plotting to become an evil mastermind.
Ansari family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar.link: Raja descends from Ayesha Ansari of Sunset Valley (Sims 3)

Bayless-Willheim household | The Sims 3.note: Stefan and Anais, a fun-loving couple who live for good food, good friends and wild parties.
Bayless-Willheim household | The Sims 3.link: Stefan descends from the Bayless family of Twinbrook (Sims 3: Ambitions)

Beach Bums household | The Sims 3 Store.note: Roommates since leaving school: Len and Suzuki grew into good-looking adults, leaving Ricardo feeling left behind and short of confidence with women.

Benton family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar.note: Athlete Benjamin and police officer Dahlia push their children into sport; Carly secretly loves music and Jax is good at everything but sport.

Best Friends household (Lucky Palms) | T.note: Childhood friends Roy Phillips and Palmer Hayes drifted apart, then retired to the same desert town and picked up where they left off.

Best Friends household (Sunlit Tides) |.note: Flirty Ursula Lemuel brought her shy, clever best friend Theodora Jayne to the island to unwind, and has her own eye on the men.

Bianchi family | The Sims 3 Store | Mont.note: Franco gave up his sports dreams for wife Kaela and son Beppe and is turning to crime for quick money; a second baby is coming.

Carnegie family | The Sims 3 Store | Sun.note: Eugene’s island holiday is spoilt by his bossy wife Ethel, while son Edmund hides away and daughter Elosie runs wild.

Chesterfield family | The Sims 3 Store |.note: Single father Bruce moved his sons Scott and Dennis from the city to the mountains to share his love of nature; Dennis isn’t happy about it.

Cho family (Hidden Springs) | The Sims 3.note: Film director Simon retired early to the spa town with wife Alisha, adopted son Davy and daughter Minzi; Davy may be Dany Shue’s lost twin.

Clark family | The Sims 3 Store | Aurora.note: Eco-loving, well-off Jessie and Wanda and their son Evan enjoy a happy, drama-free life; a second baby is on the way.

Coastal family | The Sims 3 Store | Barn.note: Jake and Josephine love Barnacle Bay’s history and the island’s wildlife, and their home shows it.

Colby family | The Sims 3 Store | Hidden.note: Newly rich Christoff and Genevieve are set on showing the old-money set a thing or two about class.

Davis-Welles family | The Sims 3 Store |.note: Mark and Rita look happily married, but both secretly love someone else (Mark, Michael Dandy; Rita, Virginia Supine); scandal looms.

Debutante household | The Sims 3 Store |.note: Childhood ‘frenemies’ Blake Grayson and Jenny Lho, living away from home for the first time on their parents’ money.

Entrepreneurs household | The Sims 3 Sto.note: Jobless roommates with big plans: Seema Sielen has the charm, Karl Simon the brains and Todd Landgraab the money.

EP9 PWT Heroes | The Sims 3 Store | | H.note: Download-only: three roommates (Haffeef Safari, Jaqualine Beels, Chris Masters) made by SimGuruBritt for the University Life producer walkthrough; in no world.

Free Spirit household | The Sims 3 Store.note: Nature-loving friends Nicholas Riverhawk, Cassidy Earthsong and Jessica Willow live sustainably in the woods, for as long as they can bear it.

Irwin family | The Sims 3 Store | Lucky.note: Jobless, unfaithful Richard (father of Lola Lancaster’s coming baby) and troubled, law-breaking Emi; can daughter Cricket have a normal childhood?

Ivanov family | The Sims 3 Store | River.note: A long-wandering musical family: Grandma Rayna Kaminski, her daughter Nadine, son-in-law Yuri Ivanov and children Tatiana and Dimitri, trying to settle.

James family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar.note: Newlyweds Phillip and Mia have furnished their home and long for a baby, and Mia is already pregnant.

James household | The Sims 3 Store | Mon.note: Top male models Jayden James and David Haynes, in town for work, trying to live normally away from the cameras.

January family | The Sims 3 Store | Luna.note: Martin moved to the edge of town for his scientist wife Lily’s work, but she neglects him and he misses the social scene.

Jones family (Roaring Heights) | The Sim.note: Widowed fashion queen Beverly can’t keep her children in style: Edward ignores fashion and Helen just wants her attention. Will she remarry?

Kelly family | The Sims 3 Store | Dragon.note: Young, fierce Ava is out to make a name for herself, and husband Sean will do anything to help.

Kent household | The Sims 3 Store | | K.note: Download-only: roommates Kim Kent, Piper Hipp and Liam O’Dourke, made by producer Grant Rodiek for a promo video; Liam also lives in Hidden Springs.

King family (Lucky Palms) | The Sims 3 S.note: Respected, popular Brayden and Kadia and their gifted twin teens Abrianna and Abrielle; what next when the girls leave home?

LaFontaine family | The Sims 3 Store | R.note: Single father Thomas is set on finding a husband for Elizabeth, who wants a simple life with no romance at all.

Lai family | The Sims 3 Store | Barnacle.note: A fishing family for generations: Gil and Laurel, son Jonah and a baby coming; their ancestors’ City Hall portraits oddly show cutlasses.

Lancaster family | The Sims 3 Store | Lu.note: Former showgirl Lola, widowed by an ‘accidental’ death, has had many suitors and is now pregnant by married Richard Irwin; daughter Lina lives elsewhere.

Lobos family | The Sims 3 Store | Riverv.note: After a troubled past, Angel wants to be a star athlete and a good father; with romantic Marisol and twins Carlotta and Anita, a fresh start.

Louie family | The Sims 3 Store | Lunar.note: Once-prestigious Pax, Louisa and daughter Nadia moved to the outskirts after Pax fell out with his boss, Patricia Cross; can they adapt?

MacAnna family | The Sims 3 Store | Drag.note: Dark, selfish Teagan and her sweet, innocent sister Shannon: complete opposites.

Malifa family | The Sims 3 Store | Barna.note: Buzz, Petunia and son Marcus: clashing tastes, clashing personalities and lots of clutter, but they make it work.

Mancini family | The Sims 3 Store | Mont.note: Carlo, raised to run the family business, has his father’s sudden death, the business and younger brother Camillo’s happiness on his shoulders.
